text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (...My throat's... dry...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Haa... What should I do~? But still~...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Palmer-san?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Waaah!? I, I didn't eat it!? I haven't 
eaten it yet, okay!?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ? ...You're saying you didn't eat?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You're so hungry you can't sleep...! 
Th-That's terrible. In that case—ah, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, taking in calories at this hour is 
so bad, right? Talk about the ultimate 
dilemma~!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: You're right... Indeed—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, in that case, I have the perfect 
special dish ready!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh, seriously? That's amazing, Flower! 
You know a godly dish like that!?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm not sure if it's divine, but... 
I'm thinking of making egg rice porridge.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It's warm and easy to digest, making it 
the perfect late-night snack!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...There's just one problem, though. I 
can't seem to recreate that comforting, 
heartwarming flavor...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Heartwarming...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes. My grandma made it for me once a long 
time ago... When I ate it back then, it 
made me feel so calm... and warmed my 
heart.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I've been trying hard to recreate that 
flavor and texture... but it's quite 
difficult.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Still, I'm sure this menu will be 
absolutely perfect for Palmer-san right 
now, so...! This time, I'll definitely 
recreate it and warm her heart!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Yep, I'm counting on you! My empty 
stomach is in your hands!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Make the dashi broth... add the washed 
rice... and a pinch of ginger... I think.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Ah... Smells so good~♪ I can't resist it!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Next... be careful not to let it boil too 
vigorously... Just simmer it low and slow 
gently.......

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Gosh, really... thank you so much, Flower.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Here you go, dig in~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I've been waiting for this!! Time to 
eat--!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
*Huff, huff*... The eggs are so fluffy~! 
*Phew*, so delicious~!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Be careful not to burn yourself, 
and take your time eating, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Aww, that really warmed my heart, Flower! 
I'll be able to sleep so soundly tonight! 
Thanks a bunch!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ! ...No, no! You're very welcome...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...And so that's what happened. Ehehe, 
Palmer-san even went out of her way to 
come tell me she slept really well!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I wonder why it went so well this 
time?"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times I tried, I could 
never recreate Grandma's recipe...
choice_data_list:
Maybe it's because you were thinking of 
someone special?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
! I see...! That's why practicing all by 
myself wasn't enough.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Making something while thinking of 
someone...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I think I'll try to do my best with 
cooking even more!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Nishino Flower resolved to improve 
her cooking skills.
